versions.content: SWC Separation Type: valid Description: The System Constraint Description has to cover the separation of SW Components. SW Component Separation means that two SW Components cannot be on the same ECU. Rationale: To enhance the independence of redundant SWC. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Two redundant Software Components, implementing safety critical functions, will not be mapped together on the same ECU because of safety requirements (of course, redundancy does not always imply SWC separation). Supporting Material: –
